results.title: Police arrest woman, offer GH¢100,000 reward for Sakumono murder suspect
results.content: The Ghana Police Service has arrested a 47-year-old woman in connection with the killing of two relatives at the NTHC Estate, Sakumono, in the Greater Accra Region, and declared the principal suspect wanted.

results.title: Ghana and Burkina Faso seek stronger trade and industrial cooperation at SIAO 2026
results.content: Ghana has reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening trade and investment relations with Burkina Faso through a proposed bilateral trade agreement aimed at promoting industrial cooperation, cross-border trade and value addition.

results.title: Savannah College of Education teachers decry 19 months without payroll migration
results.content: About one hundred and seventy striking workers of two local associations at the Savannah College of Education, namely, the Colleges of Education Teachers Association of Ghana [CETAG] and the Colleges of Education Non-Teaching Staff Association of Ghana (CENTSAG), say the unresolved issues surrounding staff remuneration, recruitment and migration of members to the government payroll are a threat to their welfare and the smooth administration of the college.

results.title: Changfans on River Tano have reduced thanks to NAIMOS – NAIMOS Spokesperson
results.content: The National Anti-Illegal Mining Operations Secretariat (NAIMOS) says the number of changfan machines operating on the River Tano has reduced significantly following sustained enforcement under its Operation Water Shield campaign against illegal mining.

results.title: Yagbonwura appeals to Mahama to intervene in Savannah College of Education staff strike
results.content: The Overlord of Gonjaland and Life Patron of the Savannah College of Education, Yagbonwura Bii-Kunuto Jewu Soale I, has appealed to President John Dramani Mahama to intervene in the ongoing strike by teaching and non-teaching staff of the institution.

results.title: Debibi United President fires back at GoldStars coach over cassava pitch comment
results.content: Debibi United Chief Executive Officer, Alexander Ababio, has hit back at the coach of Bibiani Gold Stars Petros Koukouras over his comments about the club's playing pitch, describing the remarks as reckless and unreasonable.

results.title: Niece and uncle shot dead at Sakumono over alleged GH¢500,000 debt
results.content: The police have launched investigations into the killing of a 57-year-old man and his 47-year-old niece at the NTHC Estate, Sakumono, in the Greater Accra Region, following a reported dispute over a GH¢500,000 debt.

results.title: Newsfile to discuss Mahama’s galamsey fight, GH¢49.72m evacuation controversy and five-year presidential term proposal
results.content: JoyNews’ flagship current affairs programme, Newsfile, will, this Saturday, October 31, discuss the progress of President John Mahama's administration’s fight against illegal mining, renewed questions over the GH¢49.72 million spent on evacuating Ghanaians from South Africa, and the debate over extending Ghana’s presidential term from four to five years.

results.title: Amansie Community Bank posts GH₵73m profit before tax, unprecedented GH₵1bn deposit in Ashanti Region
results.content: Amansie Community Bank PLC is streamlining its operations to sustain gains after posting a strong financial performance in the year ended December 2025.

results.title: Two Unit Committee members among 4 arrested for leasing land to galamsey operators after Abesua bridge collapse
results.content: Two Unit Committee members are among four persons arrested in connection with illegal mining activities that led to the collapse of the bridge over River Kukubu in the Abesua community of the Atwima Mponua District in the Ashanti Region.

results.title: Police arrest 40-year-old man with 91 parcels of suspected Indian hemp at Circle

results.title: Hundreds evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky during rare Ukraine ceasefire
results.content: Hundreds of residents of the devastated Russian-occupied city of Oleshky have been evacuated, Russian and Ukrainian authorities have said, following a humanitarian ceasefire brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.

results.title: Konongo, Juansa chiefs back revocation of Northern Ashanti Mines license

results.content: The Head of Sustainable Financing at Consolidated Bank Ghana (CBG), Eva Ackuaku, has expressed concern over the inability of many Ghanaian creatives to access available funding opportunities due to poor documentation and a lack of formal business structures.

results.content: The Government of Ghana has pledged to pursue justice for 15-year-old Ghanaian teenager Javits Frimpong, who was fatally shot in the Bronx, New York, on Thursday, October 29.

results.content: The Chinese People’s Liberation Army Navy hospital ship, Auspicious Ark (Hull 868), has concluded its seven-day humanitarian medical mission in Ghana after providing healthcare services to 5,909 people.

results.title: Microcredit association chair blames weak lender risk assessment for loan defaults
results.content: The National Board Chairperson of the Micro Credit Association Ghana, Benjamin Turkson Junior, has attributed loan defaults in parts of the microcredit sector to weak risk management systems among some lending institutions. He has urged financial institutions to strengthen their assessment of prospective borrowers and establish effective mechanisms to evaluate their creditworthiness before approving loans. Speaking in an interview at the Association’s Annual General Meeting in Ho, Mr Turkson argued that lenders must take greater responsibility for ensuring that loans are advanced to customers with the capacity and willingness to repay. “I have always personally developed a philosophy where I say we don’t have bad borrowers, but we have bad lenders,” he said.

results.title: NAIMOS expands crackdown on illegal mining equipment supply network
results.content: The National Anti-illegal Mining Secretariat (NAIMOS) has intercepted 65 brand new Changfang machines on suspicion they are intended for water polluting-galamsey activities in the Nzema East and Aowin municipalities in the Western and Western North regions.

results.title: JUSAG to begin strike November 2 over unpaid salary arrears
results.content: The Judicial Service Staff Association of Ghana (JUSAG) has declared an indefinite strike from Monday, November 2, 2026, following the government’s failure to approve its members’ 2026 salary review.

results.title: YPYC Foundation announces nominees for 17th Africa Role Model Awards
results.content: The Young Professionals and Youth Coalition (YPYC) Foundation has announced its shortlist for the 17th Africa Role Model Awards, with several prominent personalities from Ghana and other African countries nominated for recognition. The winners will be announced at the 17th Transform Summit and Africa Role Model Awards ceremony scheduled for Saturday, October 31, 2026, at the ISSER Conference Hall of the University of Ghana, Legon. The event, which begins at 12:00 noon, will be held under the theme, “Leadership in Action: Breaking Barriers and Building Success.” Chief of Staff, Dr Julius Debrah, is expected to attend as the Special Guest of Honour. The awards seek to recognise individuals whose contributions have made an impact in areas including traditional leadership, academia, religion, business, media, engineering, politics, education, law, energy and philanthropy.

results.title: Student pleads not guilty to stealing GH¢1.5million from Bishop Obinim
results.content: A 23-year-old student accused of stealing GH¢1.5 million belonging to Bishop Daniel Obinim has pleaded not guilty to charges of conspiracy to commit crime, to wit stealing, and stealing.
